name: overdetermined_by_one
source:
{ Three equations, two unknowns. }
x + y = 3
x - y = 1
x = 2

error.message: There are 3 equations and 2 variables. The problem is overspecified and cannot be solved. Redundant relation (no free variable left to determine): x=2. A common cause: the same physics stated twice — a boundary pinning a quantity a component already defines (a re-equated mixer pressure, a T-pinned wall state), or two property calls restating one relation.
